name: cmk-lang
description: Syntax highlighting for cmk-lang (.cmk) plus enhanced highlighting for GNU Makefiles, and a shebang-aware run button above targets, from the compose.mk project.

cmk.showRunButton.description: Show a shebang-aware 'run' button (CodeLens) above each target in .cmk files. Running a target replays the file's shebang; files with no shebang are refused.

enumDescriptions: Bold weight only. Fully supported, zero layout risk.
Bold + wider letter-spacing, so the token takes more horizontal space. Supported.
Bold + a sized colored block prepended as a pseudo-element (a genuinely bigger glyph beside the token, not a resize of it). Supported.
Bold + a rounded outline box that enlarges the token's footprint. Supported.

UNSUPPORTED HACK: injects font-size + font-weight:900 + a different font-family via the textDecoration CSS field to make the token bigger, bolder, and a distinct typeface. Line height does NOT reflow, so large scales clip the line above and skew cursor/selection. Degrades to bold+spacing if VSCode ignores the injected CSS.
cmk.emphasis.style.markdownDescription: How to emphasize banana-block delimiters `(| |)` and target names beyond what the color theme provides. VSCode has no per-token font-size, so most options approximate 'bigger' with weight/spacing/boxes; `fontSize` is an explicit opt-in to the unsupported CSS-injection hack (it degrades gracefully to bold+spacing).

cmk.emphasis.fontSizeScale.markdownDescription: Glyph scale for the `fontSize` emphasis style (em units, clamped 1.0-2.5). Higher values are more dramatic but clip the line above more severely, since the editor does not grow line height. Ignored unless `#cmk.emphasis.style#` is `fontSize`.

cmk.emphasis.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font-family injected for the `fontSize` emphasis style, so emphasized tokens render in a typeface distinct from the editor's code font. A CSS font-family list (fallbacks recommended). Only the `fontSize` style can change font-family (it rides the same unsupported CSS-injection hack); if VSCode ignores the injection, the token falls back to the editor font. Ignored unless `#cmk.emphasis.style#` is `fontSize`.

editor.tokenColorCustomizations.comments: The VSCode analogue of the docs' prism-cmk.base.css: force bold/bright colors onto cmk scopes over whatever color theme is active (the grammar only assigns scopes, it carries no color). Tuned for DARK themes -- the common cmk case. VSCode has NO per-token font-size, so the docs' 'bigger' tweaks (targets, banana) are approximated with bold/underline. Override any rule below in your own settings.json.
